_comment: Qwen golden-audio duration fixture (#1994); same text-normalization-class coverage as fixture.json; run against whichever designed Qwen voice this box has (see pick_designed_voice in tests/golden/prereq.py — Qwen voices are per-workspace bespoke, not a fixed catalog like Kokoro's, so no voice id is hardcoded here); re-bless qwen-duration-baseline.json (npm run test:golden-audio -- --sidecar-only --engine=qwen --bless) whenever this file is edited.

lines.text: The lighthouse keeper watched the grey sea roll in.
In 1999, all 7 of them boarded the 4:15 train to Dover.
Dr. Hollis and Mr. Vane arrived at St. Aldric's before noon.
"Wait," she said, "did you really mean it — all of it?"
He paused at the door. The hallway was silent. Then he stepped through.
